subject: Civil Engineering
title: Soil-Structure Interaction
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Soil-Structure Interaction.

hook.text: A building doesn't just sit on soil — it and the soil move each other during shaking.

buildup.text: Flexible soil lets the foundation rock and translate — changing the building's response.

discovery.text: Soil-structure interaction lengthens the natural period — the building sways differently than predicted.

twist.text: Sometimes SSI reduces forces. Sometimes it amplifies them — it depends on the earthquake.

climax.text: Nuclear power plants model SSI in extreme detail — safety demands precision.

punchline.text: The building and the ground are dance partners. Neither moves alone.

quiz.question: How does soil-structure interaction affect building response?
options: It always reduces earthquake forces on the building
Flexible soil changes the building's natural period, altering its seismic response
It strengthens the foundation by compacting the soil during shaking
